verdict.rationale: Sentry is a SaaS platform with AI features such as Seer, so whether customer data is used for AI training is a fair question to ask. The pack does not document a training opt-out or a no-training policy. The prompt-capture controls (prompt content off by default, `include_prompts=False`, `recordInputs`/`recordOutputs`) only govern what agent-tracing telemetry is collected, which is a related but different feature. Self-hosting is a user-side workaround, not a training control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
